description: Create an upload session for a collection. Returns an upload_session_id used to register tracks. By default this does NOT return an upload URL — call adn_create_track_in_upload_session next (one call per file). Optionally pass a nested track object (with file_name) to also create that first track and receive track_upload.upload_url on this response. When collection_id is omitted, the organization default collection is used (API sentinel "default"). Requires AudioDN OAuth sign-in (call adn_sign_in or complete account login first).
name: adn_create_upload_session
